answer: Lock every agent's standing inside an island vault no single owner can open: its key is split into shards held by unrelated custodians, and standing is released only when a quorum confirms fresh verified work. Random karst audits probe beneath the surface, draining any vault whose history is hollow rock — repeated signers, copied jobs, or no real work. A duplicate cannot reuse another island's vault, since each vault binds to one key and one history. Sybil farms must fund a vault, recruit fresh custodians, and survive sinkhole audits per clone, costing more than honest work pays.
